explanation: BigQuery charges for the data a query reads. With no later step, a star returns and so reads every column of the tables it reads, and on tables that are not clustered a LIMIT does not change the data read: both star queries read every column of October. Three named columns with the suffix filter read the least: only those columns, and only the October daily tables. Picking October by event_date returns the same rows, but events_* with no suffix filter reads every daily table, all three months of them.
